gather.cond: Glittering galena lines the walls of the upper caverns.
gather.riskWhy: Upper caverns with galena walls; rats and centipedes patrol.

gather.cond: Crystal-lined pockets in the cave walls.
gather.riskWhy: Wall pockets in well-trodden caves; a spider or stirge may drop by.

environments.name: Underwater & Deep Seas
environments.desc: Kelp forests, coral reefs and lightless trenches where the pressure alone can kill. Sharks, merrow and sahuagin patrol the richest beds.
environments.forage: Requires water breathing or held breath; each dive lasts only as long as your breath. Currents and pressure grow deadly below 100 feet.

gather.cond: In kelp forests near the surface; only the youngest fronds hold their magic.
gather.riskWhy: Shallow kelp beds near the surface; reef sharks and octopi drift through the fronds.

gather.cond: Carpets every shallow rock.
gather.riskWhy: Shallow rocks by the tideline; the worst here is a pinching crab.

gather.cond: On warm reefs; the coral's edge deals 1d4 slashing damage.
gather.riskWhy: Warm reefs teem with life, and reef sharks cruise the edges for anything bleeding.

gather.cond: On deep reef walls below 100 feet; DC 13 Con save vs pressure.

guard.note: A merrow band claims the reef wall and ambushes divers in the gloom.

gather.riskWhy: Merrow ambush grounds in the gloom below 100 feet; hunter sharks follow the blood.

gather.cond: In oyster beds; pry them open with a knife — roughly one oyster in twenty holds a pearl.
gather.riskWhy: Oyster beds draw crabs and octopi; a shark may circle a diver prying shells.

gather.cond: Only in deep oyster beds in cold water, one in a hundred oysters; a week of diving per find.

guard.note: A young bronze dragon counts the pearls of these beds as part of its hoard.

gather.riskWhy: Pearls counted in a dragon's hoard; a week of diving in its beds will not go unnoticed.

gather.cond: On sandy sea beds; check for living occupants before you grab (the cone shells sting: DC 11 Con vs poison).
gather.riskWhy: Open sandy sea beds; little cover from a passing shark.

gather.cond: From the dark reef-slopes at night, when the living nautilus rise.
gather.riskWhy: Night on the dark reef-slopes, when every predator rises with the nautilus.

gather.cond: In submerged cliff faces at 30–60 feet; each find requires a DC 12 Athletics check against the surge.
gather.riskWhy: Cliff faces at 30-60 feet; clinging against the surge makes you easy prey.

gather.cond: Only in the deepest trenches; requires magic to survive the pressure (4d6 bludgeoning per minute without).

guard.note: An aboleth drifts in the trench and bends the minds of divers who come for its kelp.

gather.riskWhy: The aboleth's trench; its enslaved chuul and worse haunt the lightless deep.

gather.cond: In shallow, sunny waters.
gather.riskWhy: Sunny shallows within wading distance; only quippers and crabs.

gather.cond: Floating in whale-feeding grounds; rare and valuable.

guard.note: Killer whales feed in the same grounds and treat divers as seals.

gather.riskWhy: Whale-feeding grounds, where orcas treat swimmers as seals and sharks trail the pods.

gather.cond: Around hot volcanic vents on the sea floor; the water is scalding (DC 12 Con save or 2d6 fire damage).
gather.riskWhy: Scalding vents keep most life away, but a chuul may lurk in the warm murk.

gather.cond: Chipped from quartz veins exposed on submerged cliffs near volcanic vents; the rock is hot and the water murky.
gather.riskWhy: Murky water by the vents hides ambushers; the chipping carries far underwater.

gather.cond: In cold kelp beds where a spring of elemental water wells up through the seabed; the fronds stream against the tide and tangle swimmers (DC 13 Athletics).
gather.riskWhy: Tangling fronds by an elemental spring; swimmers caught fast attract hunters.

gather.cond: Welling from a vent on the seabed where a spring of Elemental Water breaks through; it glows faintly and sinks, so cork it at the vent.

guard.note: A water elemental has come through the vent and treats the spring as its gate home.

gather.riskWhy: The vent is an elemental's gate home, and it guards the spring jealously.

environments.name: Cities & Towns
environments.desc: Crowded streets, sewers, gardens and graveyards. Foraging in a city is less about nature and more about knowing where to look — and whose land you are on.
environments.forage: Easy but usually illegal: foraging in private gardens, churchyards or noble estates risks fines or worse. Markets sell most mundane reagents.

gather.cond: Scraped from flues; chimney sweeps sell it cheap.
gather.riskWhy: Bought from sweeps or scraped from a flue; a startled rooftop cat at worst.

gather.cond: In the sewers and damp alleys; DC 10 Con save vs disease each hour below.
gather.riskWhy: Down in the sewers with rat swarms, wererats and whatever eats the refuse.

gather.cond: Climbing old city walls and tenement buildings.
gather.riskWhy: Grows on the city walls in plain view; pigeons and the odd guard glance.

gather.cond: Only in old cemeteries; picking it on hallowed ground risks the priests' anger.
gather.riskWhy: Old cemeteries at dusk: angry sextons, rats, and the rare restless corpse.

gather.cond: From churchyard yews; requires the church's permission or a bribe.
gather.riskWhy: A churchyard tree in daylight; the only danger is the vicar's temper.

gather.cond: In the crypts beneath old temples; the priests do not welcome grave-robbers.
gather.riskWhy: Crypts beneath the temples, where the dead and the grave-guardians stir.

gather.cond: Scraped from bronze statues and copper roofs at night.
gather.riskWhy: Rooftops and statues after dark; the watch, stray dogs, and gargoyles that aren't.

gather.cond: In the herb gardens and cloisters of temples; the monks sell it cheaply.
gather.riskWhy: Bought from the monks in the cloister; entirely safe.

gather.cond: In temple gardens; the priests trade it for donations.
gather.riskWhy: Traded for a donation in the temple garden; nothing to fear.

gather.cond: In cracks in old walls and alleys.
gather.riskWhy: Wall cracks along ordinary alleys; a stray cat or rat at most.

gather.cond: In damp parks and riverbanks.
gather.riskWhy: Damp parks and riverbanks in town; ducks and dogs.

gather.cond: From rooftop hives; the beekeeper may object.
gather.riskWhy: Rooftop hives: stinging bees and a beekeeper with a dog.

gather.cond: From abandoned rooftop hives; the bees may not have left.
gather.riskWhy: Abandoned hives may still hold a furious colony, and rooftops are slippery.

gather.cond: From the riverbanks below the potters' quarter.
gather.riskWhy: Riverbank below the potters' quarter, busy with workmen all day.

gather.cond: In the herb gardens of physicians and apothecaries.
gather.riskWhy: A physician's herb garden; ask, pay, or dodge the guard dog.

gather.cond: In the dyers' fields just outside the city walls.
gather.riskWhy: Dyers' fields outside the walls; a stray dog or a goat at worst.

gather.cond: From the spoil heaps of the tanners' and dyers' quarter.
gather.riskWhy: Spoil heaps in the tanners' quarter; rats and desperate folk pick over them too.

gather.cond: Salvaged from demolished temples and old buildings; the masons' guild may object.
gather.riskWhy: Demolished temples attract scavengers, and old statuary sometimes moves.

gather.cond: Rank around the gibbets and paupers' pits outside the city walls, where the condemned died afraid; the stings leave you jumpy for an hour.
gather.riskWhy: Gibbets and paupers' pits draw carrion birds, ghouls and the unquiet condemned.

environments.name: Ruins & Dungeons
environments.desc: Crumbling temples, forgotten tombs and the lairs of dead wizards. Magic lingers here in strange residues, and so do traps, guardians and the restless dead.
environments.forage: Every search risks disturbing something; roll for traps or wandering undead each hour. Residues are best near the site of old spellwork.

gather.cond: Scraped from scorched circles where old spells were cast; stray magic may trigger (DC 13 Dex save or 2d6 force).
gather.riskWhy: Old casting circles still attract the constructs and oddities bound to them.

gather.cond: From broken ward-stones and toppled altars; some still hold a trap.

guard.note: A gargoyle perches among the broken ward-stones, pretending to be one of them.

gather.riskWhy: A gargoyle perches among the ward-stones; the broken wards may hold more.

gather.cond: On forgotten graves and barrow mounds.
gather.riskWhy: Barrow mounds are rarely as empty as they look; skeletons and wights sleep lightly.

gather.cond: On old coffins and sarcophagi; DC 11 Con save vs disease.
gather.riskWhy: Scraping a coffin wakes its occupant, and ghouls feed in such crypts.

gather.cond: Smothering fallen walls.
gather.riskWhy: Outer walls in the open; snakes and centipedes nest in the rubble.

gather.cond: In buried courtyards, where ancient gardens turned to stone.

guard.note: A basilisk lairs in the buried courtyard, and not every stone tree there was always a tree.

gather.riskWhy: The basilisk's own courtyard, its prey turned to statues around you.

gather.cond: Only where the last defenders fell, feeding on centuries-old blood; it grows thickest before a storm.
gather.riskWhy: Old battlefields where the fallen rise, and stirges come for the blood.

gather.cond: In abandoned witches' cottages; the last owner may not be as dead as the locals hope.
gather.riskWhy: A witch's abandoned cottage; the witch, or her leftovers, may still be home.

gather.cond: In damp cellars.
gather.riskWhy: Damp cellars: rats, centipedes and the occasional ooze.

gather.cond: From damp crypt walls.
gather.riskWhy: Crypt walls, with restless dead in the niches beside you.

gather.cond: Pried from old tomb decorations; tomb curses are known to follow looters.

guard.note: The tomb's mummy wakes when its decorations are pried loose.

gather.riskWhy: Prying a tomb's decorations wakes its mummy and its curse.

gather.cond: Pried from mourning ornaments on old sarcophagi; disturbing the lid may wake the occupant.
gather.riskWhy: Mourning ornaments on sarcophagi; lift the lid and the occupant lifts too.

gather.cond: Only in haunted halls where a spirit has lingered for a century; it is found by its scent of rain.

guard.note: The lingering spirit whose presence grows the ghostpetals does not want them picked.

gather.riskWhy: The haunting spirit itself tends the petals and resents every theft.

gather.cond: Where the Shadowfell touches the world through old tragedies.
gather.riskWhy: Where the Shadowfell bleeds through, shadows and wraiths slip in too.

gather.cond: Rampant in overgrown temple gardens and castle moats in late summer; gloves advised.
gather.riskWhy: Overgrown gardens and moats: snakes, spiders and a lurking ooze.

gather.cond: Only on the mouldering shelves of lost libraries; the moss grows on the oldest books first.

guard.note: One of the lost library's bookcases is a mimic that has fed on scholars for years.

gather.riskWhy: A lost library whose bookcase eats scholars, among other hungry things.

gather.cond: In the dark cellars beneath abandoned towers; the spores cause vivid dreams if you sleep nearby.
gather.riskWhy: Dark cellars under abandoned towers, home to spiders, oozes and grick.

gather.cond: In the sealed sanctum of a wizard who died while projecting to the Astral Sea; the severed cord still hangs in the air above the body.

guard.note: The wizard's clay golem still guards the sanctum and does not know its master is dead.

gather.riskWhy: A sealed sanctum still guarded by the dead wizard's golem and wards.

gather.cond: Among the rubble of a fallen wizard's tower, where shards of the master's shattered ioun stones still circle the broken orrery.

guard.note: The wizard's shield guardian still stands in the tower and fights for the shards it was told to protect.

gather.riskWhy: The shield guardian still defends the orrery, and the tower has other wardens.

gather.cond: Nightshade and thorn-apple thrive in the rubble of old gardens.
gather.riskWhy: Outer rubble of old gardens; snakes and spiders shelter among the weeds.

environments.name: The Feywild
environments.desc: A brighter, wilder echo of the mortal world where colours are too vivid and time runs strange. Everything is beautiful, and everything has a price.
environments.forage: Plentiful, but fey own everything: take without asking and a debt is owed. Each day spent foraging requires a DC 12 Wisdom save or time slips (roll 1d6: on a 1, a week passes in the mortal world).

gather.cond: Only under a full moon; picked in daylight, it withers into dust.
gather.riskWhy: Full-moon glades are fey revel grounds; blink dogs and satyrs dance there.

gather.cond: Shaken from giant fey blossoms at dawn; DC 13 Wisdom save or charmed by the nearest fey for an hour.
gather.riskWhy: Charmed at dawn beside the fey who own the blossoms: a gift to a hag.

gather.cond: Grows in a dreaming orchard guarded by fey; each fruit must be paid for with a memory.

guard.note: An oni posing as a fey orchard-keeper takes the memory-price for each fruit and eats it.

gather.riskWhy: The orchard-keeper is an oni who eats memories, and it wants yours.

gather.cond: Common in the twilight groves; it quietly moves away from careless hands.
gather.riskWhy: Twilight groves are calm enough, though sprites watch careless hands.

gather.cond: Branches shed willingly by the trees, if asked politely.
gather.riskWhy: Asked politely, the trees give freely; rudeness wakes them.

gather.cond: From the weeping moonwillows beside silver lakes; the dryad must agree.

guard.note: An old treant, sworn to the dryads of the lake, rouses if a branch is cut without leave.

gather.riskWhy: The dryad's own willows, and her treant keeps watch beside the lake.

gather.cond: In fey meadows; it finds you, not the other way around — no check if you're lucky enough.
gather.riskWhy: Lucky meadows; the pixies who planted it might want a game or a debt.

gather.cond: From a perfect faerie ring; stepping inside the ring may teleport you (DC 13 Wisdom save).
gather.riskWhy: Faerie rings belong to someone; step wrong and you're in their court.

gather.cond: Collected at the first moment of dawn; it evaporates within an hour.

guard.note: A young gold dragon sips the dew at dawn and resents anyone who takes it before she has drunk.

gather.riskWhy: A gold dragon's dawn drink; take it first and face a wounded pride.

gather.cond: Only in the heart of an eternal spring grove tended by an old treant; digging it offends the archfey.

guard.note: An adult green dragon has bargained with the archfey to guard the eternal grove in exchange for a place to lair.

gather.riskWhy: An archfey's grove, a treant's charge, and an adult green dragon's lair.

gather.cond: In the Summer Court's gardens, where every rose is watched by a pixie gardener.
gather.riskWhy: Summer Court gardens, where every rose has a pixie watcher and a price.

gather.cond: In the dusk meadows of the Dusk Court; its perfume forces a DC 13 Con save or sleep for 1 hour.
gather.riskWhy: Fall asleep in the Dusk Court meadows and something will find you.

gather.cond: Grows huge overnight in fey woods; one mushroom may be the roof of a sprite's home.
gather.riskWhy: Pick the wrong cap and an angry sprite household comes out swinging.

gather.cond: Hides under giant fern fronds; it shrinks away as you reach for it (DC 13 Dex check).
gather.riskWhy: Fern thickets; the flower hides, and only a curious sprite notices you.

gather.cond: Only where the veil between the Feywild and another plane is paper-thin; you must look away to see it.

guard.note: An invisible stalker, bound by an archfey, watches the thin place and kills whoever looks too long.

gather.riskWhy: A thin place watched by a bound invisible stalker, and whatever slips through.

gather.cond: Blooms once a century in the heart of the Feywild; every archfey wants it, and all of them know when it opens.

guard.note: An ancient green dragon has lain coiled around the wishbloom's glade for a century, waiting for it to open.

gather.riskWhy: An ancient green dragon coils round it, and every archfey's servant is coming.

gather.cond: Lying in the beds of moonlit streams; only visible when the moon's reflection falls on it.

guard.note: A unicorn drinks from the moonlit streams and will not suffer greedy gatherers.

gather.riskWhy: A unicorn's drinking stream; greed here brings its horn down on you.

gather.cond: In gardens of the Dusk Court where the archfey hold their silent councils; it hums at your thoughts, and the fey notice.

guard.note: A guardian naga keeps the Dusk Court's council gardens and the secrets spoken in them.

gather.riskWhy: The Dusk Court's council gardens; its naga warden hears your thoughts.

gather.cond: Everywhere, and absurdly fragrant. Picking them is usually allowed.
gather.riskWhy: Everywhere and freely given; even the fey rarely mind.

environments.name: The Shadowfell
environments.desc: A grey, drained reflection of the world where colour bleeds away and despair seeps into the soul. The dead walk its ashen fields, and its few plants feed on sorrow rather than sunlight.
environments.forage: Each day spent foraging requires a DC 12 Wisdom save vs despair (on a failure, disadvantage on checks until a long rest outside the plane). Anything taken here tastes of ash for a week.

gather.cond: On the shadowed side of standing stones; it only lifts cleanly in total darkness — gather it by touch.
gather.riskWhy: Groping blind in total dark at the stones, where shadows feel right at home.

gather.cond: Swept from the cold pyres of the unmourned dead; each handful deals 1d4 necrotic damage to bare skin.
gather.riskWhy: Pyres of the unmourned; their ghosts and ghouls resent the sweeping.

gather.cond: Only in the deepest valleys where no light has ever fallen; its floss unravels if exposed to any light before it is spun.

guard.note: Cloakers glide over the lightless valley, indistinguishable from the dark, and smother anyone fumbling among the thistles.

gather.riskWhy: Cloakers hunt the lightless valley, and shadows gather thick around them.

gather.cond: Beside ruined homes where grief was greatest; picking it forces a DC 12 Wis save or you weep uncontrollably for 1 minute.
gather.riskWhy: Ruined homes of great grief draw ghosts back to them.

gather.cond: Crusted along the shores of a still grey lake; wading in to reach the best crust requires a DC 13 Wis save vs despair.
gather.riskWhy: A still grey lake whose drowned dead wait for waders.

gather.cond: Carpets the ashen fields of the dead; the dead there resent the theft.
gather.riskWhy: The ashen fields of the dead, who rise to stop the theft.

gather.cond: From the grey, leafless forests; the trees whisper names as you cut, and a DC 13 Wis save avoids being frightened for an hour.
gather.riskWhy: Whispering grey forests; ravens flock and the whisperers sometimes follow.

gather.cond: Thick on the doors of every crypt; DC 11 Con save vs disease.
gather.riskWhy: Every crypt door here has a hungry occupant behind it.

gather.cond: In lightless caverns beneath the grey mountains; any light makes the crystal crumble.

guard.note: A spirit naga, reborn again and again in the dark, claims the crystal caverns as its tomb.

gather.riskWhy: A spirit naga's tomb-caverns, lightless and haunted by its undead servants.

gather.cond: In oyster beds under black, lightless water; wraiths guard the beds and the cold deals 2d6 necrotic damage per minute submerged.

guard.note: An adult black dragon, gone grey and shadow-touched, lairs in the black water above the beds.

gather.riskWhy: Wraiths guard the beds, and a shadow-touched black dragon lairs above them.

gather.cond: Floating in stagnant pools in the dread swamps; handling it barehanded forces a DC 15 Con save vs poison.

guard.note: A young black dragon wallows in the dread-swamp pools and uses the lotus to poison its rivals.

gather.riskWhy: A young black dragon's wallow, deep in dread-swamp full of drowned dead.

gather.cond: Hauled from the grey peat-bogs, black as the sky; the bodies preserved beside it sometimes open their eyes.
gather.riskWhy: The bog bodies beside the oak do not always stay dead.

gather.cond: Weathered out of the ashen soil in abundance; the pieces are cold and heavy with grief.
gather.riskWhy: Weathered out of open ashen soil; skeletons and ravens wander by.

gather.cond: Around the crooked huts of the grey marshes; their owners are rarely far away.

guard.note: A night hag keeps a hut among these patches and harvests the dreams of trespassers.

gather.riskWhy: A night hag's hut stands among the patches, and her nightmare grazes nearby.

gather.cond: In the ash-filled veins beneath abandoned cursed demiplanes; the stone reflects the face of whoever you have lost.

guard.note: The vampire lord of the nearest cursed demiplane mines these veins with thralls and misses every stone.

gather.riskWhy: A vampire lord's mine, worked by thralls and patrolled by his spawn.

environments.name: Elemental Plane of Fire
environments.desc: A realm of burning seas, rivers of magma and sulphur skies, lit by the eternal glow of the efreet's brass cities. Salamanders, efreet and living flame rule here.
environments.forage: Without fire immunity or strong protection, every hour deals 5d10 fire damage; even protected, metal tools grow too hot to hold after an hour.

gather.cond: Snatched from the trailing edge of a living firestorm; seal it in a crystal phial or iron brazier within an hour, or it dies.

guard.note: An adult red dragon rides the living firestorms and fights anyone who chases the same embers.

gather.riskWhy: You chase the same firestorm an adult red dragon rides, amid living flame that resents being caught.

gather.cond: Crusted on the ash-flats beside magma rivers; wet it and it explodes (2d6 fire).
gather.riskWhy: The ash-flats edge the magma rivers, where magmin and salamanders drift out of the glow.

gather.cond: Knapped from the cooled skin of magma rivers; step through the crust and take 10d10 fire damage.

guard.note: Salamanders glide over the magma rivers and take knappers for poachers.

gather.riskWhy: Salamanders patrol the river crust and treat every knapper as a poacher.

gather.cond: From the coal-seams around the efreet's brass city; the efreet demand a tithe of every find.

guard.note: An efreeti tithe-collector patrols the coal-seams and takes its share by force if it is not offered.

gather.riskWhy: Efreet land: the tithe-collector and its azer crews notice anyone digging untaxed.

gather.cond: Only at the blinding heart of the plane, where the first fire burns; catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute. Approaching deals 10d10 fire damage per round without immunity.

guard.note: An ancient red dragon has made the first fire its hearth and sleeps beside it.

gather.riskWhy: The first fire is an ancient red dragon's hearth, ringed by the plane's oldest elementals.

gather.cond: Crusted around every vent; gather quickly — the vents erupt without warning (DC 12 Dex save or 3d6 fire).
gather.riskWhy: Common vent-crust; only mephits and wandering magmin bother a quick gatherer.

gather.cond: In every cooling lava field; its edges cut deep (1d4 slashing).
gather.riskWhy: Lava fields lie open to view; magmin wander them, but little lairs there.

gather.cond: On the shores of the burning seas.
gather.riskWhy: Burning-sea shores are quiet by this plane's measure: steam mephits and the odd salamander.

gather.cond: Formed in slowly cooling lava tubes; DC 14 Con save vs heat each hour inside.

guard.note: Fire giants quarry the lava tubes for gems to set in their hearths and forges.

gather.riskWhy: Fire giants quarry these tubes for their forges, with hell hounds at heel.

gather.cond: In magma-veined tunnels deep beneath the plane's crust; only during the brief cooling cycles.

guard.note: A young red dragon burrows through the cooling tunnels hunting the same rubies.

gather.riskWhy: A young red dragon burrows the same tunnels for the same gems.

gather.cond: Near planar rifts to the Lower Planes, where fiends trade with efreet.

guard.note: Hell hounds left behind by fiendish traders prowl the rift edges.

gather.riskWhy: Rift edges where fiends trade with efreet; stray hell hounds hunt there.

gather.cond: At the border with Elemental Earth, where fire meets stone; picking it is safe only in fire-resistant gloves.
gather.riskWhy: The fire-stone border draws both magmin and roving earth elementals.

gather.cond: Sprouting in the ash-drifts at the plane's cooler edges.
gather.riskWhy: The plane's cooler edges; a few mephits and magmin drift through the ash.

gather.cond: Glittering in cooled basalt at the plane's edge, where the heat is merely unbearable.
gather.riskWhy: Out at the fringe, far from the brass cities; mostly azer prospectors and mephits.

gather.cond: Blood-red crusts around mercury-steam vents; the fumes force a DC 13 Con save or poisoned 1 hour.
gather.riskWhy: Steam vents host mischievous mephits, but nothing hunts here in earnest.

gather.cond: Only in the treasure-veins of the efreet's own mines beneath their brass city; theft means a death sentence.

guard.note: An iron golem forged by the efreet stands in the treasure-vein and never sleeps.

gather.riskWhy: Theft from the efreet's own treasure-vein; the golem never sleeps and the efreet never forgive.

environments.name: Elemental Plane of Water
environments.desc: An endless ocean without surface or floor, lit by the glow of coral islands and the lanterns of the marids. The currents here are alive — and not all of them are friendly.
environments.forage: Water breathing is essential; without a fixed point, a DC 13 Survival check each hour avoids being swept miles away by a current.

gather.cond: From oysters in the clear heart of the plane; one per hundred oysters.

guard.note: A storm giant keeps these oyster beds as her private garden and reads omens in their pearls.

gather.riskWhy: A storm giant's private oyster garden; she reads its pearls and misses every one.

gather.cond: Collected from dense, glowing brine currents; seal quickly before it mixes with ordinary water.
gather.riskWhy: Glowing brine currents are the paths water elementals ride, and sharks follow them.

gather.cond: In vast kelp forests that stream against the current; they tangle swimmers (DC 13 Athletics).
gather.riskWhy: Tangled kelp forests hide octopuses, merrow and hags waiting for a snared swimmer.

gather.cond: From the frozen frontier where Water meets Air; the cold deals 4d6 cold damage per hour.

guard.note: An adult white dragon dens in the frozen frontier and guards the ice it sleeps on.

gather.riskWhy: The frozen frontier is an adult white dragon's bed; you chip at its pillow.

gather.cond: Only in the deepest reach of the plane, guarded by the marids; the pearl must be earned, not stolen.

guard.note: The marids keep a kraken leashed in the deepest reach to deal with thieves.

gather.riskWhy: The marids' deepest vault, with a leashed kraken to deal with thieves.

gather.cond: Swaying in the bright shallows around coral islands; the youngest fronds are the strongest.
gather.riskWhy: Bright island shallows; reef sharks and curious merrow at worst.

gather.cond: In cold, lightless depths far from any island, where the pressure alone deals 2d6 bludgeoning per hour without magic.

guard.note: An ancient aboleth drifts in the cold depths, and the kelp beds are its larder.

gather.riskWhy: The cold kelp beds are an aboleth's larder, and it minds its larder.

gather.cond: Oyster beds on the flanks of coral islands; the tritons expect a courtesy gift.
gather.riskWhy: Island oyster beds are neighbourly waters; bring a gift and watch for crabs and sharks.

gather.cond: From cold, deep oyster beds in the dark currents; one find per week of diving.

guard.note: A hydra swims over the dark beds and snaps up any diver it sees.

gather.riskWhy: A week of diving under a hydra that snaps up anything it sees.

gather.cond: Snapped from the living coral islands; the reef defends itself (1d4 slashing per piece).
gather.riskWhy: Living reef flanks; bleeding hands draw the odd reef shark.

gather.cond: On the dim, deep reefs below the islands, where the light is blue and the water cold.
gather.riskWhy: Dim, cold deep reefs where bigger hunters rise from below.

gather.cond: Embedded in the stone cores of coral islands; you must dig through living coral.
gather.riskWhy: Digging through living coral clouds the water with blood and noise; sharks come to look.

gather.cond: Drifting empty in the currents, shed by the plane's great spiral-shelled beasts.
gather.riskWhy: Empty shells drift free; their huge makers are rarely close, though currents carry sharks.

environments.name: Elemental Plane of Air
environments.desc: An infinite sky of wind, cloud and floating islands of rock, lashed by eternal storms. Djinn, air elementals and invisible stalkers ride the currents.
environments.forage: Flight or a stable earthmote is essential; each hour of foraging requires a DC 12 Strength save or you are blown away. Storms strike without warning.

gather.cond: Forms in the wake of eternal storms; catch it before it falls — and take 3d6 lightning damage in the process.

guard.note: A djinni sails the eternal storms collecting the glass for its palace windows.

gather.riskWhy: A djinni harvests this glass for its palace and dislikes rival collectors in its storm.

gather.cond: Harvested from dense cloudbanks; it disperses if not bundled quickly.

guard.note: An air elemental roams the cloudbanks and scatters anyone bundling them.

gather.riskWhy: Cloudbanks are an air elemental's roaming ground; it scatters bundlers for sport.

gather.cond: Chipped from floating islands of rock; the fragments float away if not tied down at once.
gather.riskWhy: Chipping a floating rock is quiet work; mephits and gargoyles perch on some.

gather.cond: Only inside a colossal thunderhead; each minute inside deals 4d10 thunder damage.

guard.note: An adult blue dragon flies into the thunderhead to bathe in its lightning and claims the shards.

gather.riskWhy: An adult blue dragon bathes in this thunderhead and counts the shards as its own.

gather.cond: Only in the still heart of the Great Maelstrom; reaching it requires surviving the eye-wall.

guard.note: An ancient blue dragon circles the still eye of the Maelstrom as its private lair.

gather.riskWhy: The Maelstrom's eye is an ancient blue dragon's lair, walled by furious elementals.

gather.cond: Drifting in clouds on every breeze; net them from the lee of an earthmote.
gather.riskWhy: Netted from a mote's sheltered lee; only drifting mephits and birds share the breeze.

gather.cond: On the windward faces of floating earthmotes; the seedheads try to escape (DC 13 Dex check).

guard.note: A cloud giant's floating estate trails these earthmotes, and it counts the thistles as its crop.

gather.riskWhy: A cloud giant's crop, and its floating estate is never far behind.

gather.cond: Fringing the undersides of floating islands; you must hang over the endless sky to reach them.
gather.riskWhy: Hanging under a rock island; gargoyles roost there and mephits enjoy a push.

gather.cond: On sandy earthmotes freshly struck by lightning; wait for the next strike to pass first.
gather.riskWhy: Waiting out lightning on a storm-struck mote; blue dragons love the same storms.

gather.cond: Forming on the frozen border with Elemental Water, where the wind turns to ice; 2d6 cold damage per hour.
gather.riskWhy: The frozen Water border brings ice mephits and the white wyrms that follow the cold.

gather.cond: In the sky-blue veins of floating islands, which the djinn mine for their palaces.
gather.riskWhy: Djinn mine these veins, and their invisible servants watch over the diggings.

gather.cond: Inside lightning-scarred earthmotes; the gem still crackles (1 lightning damage) when pried loose.
gather.riskWhy: Lightning-scarred motes sit in storm lanes where air elementals and blue wyrmlings play.

environments.name: Elemental Plane of Earth
environments.desc: A world of solid stone, twisting tunnels and caverns the size of kingdoms, lit only by glowing gems. Earth elementals, xorn and the dao rule this crushing realm.
environments.forage: A way to breathe and move through stone is essential; tunnels can close without warning (DC 14 Dex save or 6d6 bludgeoning and restrained).

gather.cond: Deep in the plane, where the heartbeat of the earth can be felt; the geode's guardian elementals do not like thieves.

guard.note: A purple worm tunnels in circles around the heartbeat of the plane and swallows diggers whole.

gather.riskWhy: A purple worm circles the plane's heartbeat and swallows diggers whole.

gather.cond: Cut from the flowing walls of shifting tunnels; it must be cut while it flows, or it hardens to ordinary stone.

guard.note: Stone giant pilgrims shape the flowing walls as sacred art and do not forgive those who cut them.

gather.riskWhy: Cutting a stone giant's sacred wall-art while it still flows is a mortal insult.

gather.cond: In the gem-lit caverns; xorn follow the smell of fresh cuts.

guard.note: Xorn follow the smell of fresh cuts and will fight for a good cluster.

gather.riskWhy: Fresh cuts smell like dinner to xorn, and they will fight you for a good cluster.

gather.cond: From the core of the plane, where the pressure could crush a mountain; the dao guard it jealously.

guard.note: An ancient copper dragon tunnelled down into the plane chasing the stone's glitter, and now sleeps coiled around it.

gather.riskWhy: An ancient copper dragon sleeps coiled around the plane's core, and the dao want it too.

gather.cond: Silvery veins that glint in gem-light, far richer than any mortal mine; xorn eat them faster than you can dig.

guard.note: A hungry xorn eats through these veins and does not share.

gather.riskWhy: Xorn devour these veins and don't share; rust monsters sniff after the same metal.

gather.cond: Black-green veins near the plane's iron heart; every hour of mining breaks a pick on a failed DC 14 check.

guard.note: An earth elemental guards the iron heart and rises out of the vein itself.

gather.riskWhy: The iron heart's guardian rises out of the very vein you are hacking at.

gather.cond: Pressed into being by the plane's crushing weight, deep below the gem caverns; tunnels there collapse often (DC 15 Dex save or 6d6 bludgeoning).

guard.note: A behir hunts the collapsing tunnels below the gem caverns, drawn by the noise of picks.

gather.riskWhy: Pick-noise in collapsing tunnels calls a hunting behir.

gather.cond: In green-lit caverns where the stone hums; the crystal walls cut hands (1d4 slashing) as you pry.

guard.note: A stone golem left by a long-gone dao still guards the humming green caverns.

gather.riskWhy: A dao's forgotten stone golem still guards the humming green halls.

gather.cond: In frost-cold pockets near the border with Elemental Water; a DC 13 Con save vs cold each hour.

guard.note: A frost giant prospecting band has tunnelled in from the frozen border and claims every cold-blue stone it finds.

gather.riskWhy: A frost giant prospecting band claims every cold-blue stone, winter wolves in tow.

gather.cond: Wherever iron tools tug toward the walls; drop your weapons first or they stick fast.
gather.riskWhy: You work disarmed, and stuck iron on the walls draws metal-hungry xorn.

gather.cond: In the stone forests of long-fallen worlds, swallowed by the plane; follow the ring-patterns in the rock.
gather.riskWhy: Swallowed stone forests are still places; gargoyles and the odd basilisk haunt them.

gather.cond: Threading through solid stone near earth-and-fire borders; chisel it out whole or it withers.
gather.riskWhy: The earth-fire border draws magmin and elementals from both planes.

gather.cond: Clusters light every major cavern; the dao consider them public lamps, so take only broken shards.
gather.riskWhy: Public lamps in busy caverns; take broken shards and only mephits mind you.

gather.cond: Veins run through nearly every wall; easy picking.
gather.riskWhy: Iron is in every wall; the only rivals are xorn and rust monsters passing by.

gather.cond: In cool green veins deep in the plane; it rings when tapped, so you can hear where it is.
gather.riskWhy: Deep veins that ring when tapped, and xorn listen for the ringing.

gather.cond: In blue-and-gold seams that the dao carve into their palaces.
gather.riskWhy: These are the dao's palace seams; their gargoyle and elemental servants patrol them.

gather.cond: In green-banded caverns near copper veins; the dust is toxic in enclosed spaces (DC 11 Con save).
gather.riskWhy: Quiet copper caverns, dangerous more for the dust than for any beast.

gather.cond: In pink crystal grottoes; the dao consider these their gardens.
gather.riskWhy: Picking crystals in a dao's garden; its gargoyle wardens take offence.

environments.name: The Lower Planes
environments.desc: The Hells, the Abyss and the grim wastes between: sulphur skies, rivers of blood and fire, and fiends who see every mortal as a resource. What grows here is cruel, and everything is owned by someone worse than you.
environments.forage: Each hour of foraging risks a fiendish patrol; evil planes also impose a DC 12 Wisdom save each day or your alignment slowly shifts. Devils may accept a contract in exchange for safe gathering.

gather.cond: Scattered on the smouldering plains of the first Hell; the fumes force a DC 12 Con save or poisoned for 1 hour.
gather.riskWhy: The first Hell's plains are patrolled; lemures shamble and devils look for strays.

gather.cond: Swept from the battlefields of the endless war between devils and demons; it still smells of blood.
gather.riskWhy: Blood War battlefields: stragglers from both sides still wander the ash.

gather.cond: Caught from the fire-rivers of the Hells; seal it in iron within an hour or it dies. Holding it deals 2d6 fire damage per round.

guard.note: A horned devil commands the fire-river's garrison and treats ember-thieves as deserters.

gather.riskWhy: A horned devil's garrison holds the fire-river and hunts ember-thieves as deserters.

gather.cond: From the slag-mines of the deeper Hells, worked by damned souls; the overseers do not welcome competition.

guard.note: Bone devil overseers drive the damned in the slag-mines and flay intruders on sight.

gather.riskWhy: Bone devil overseers work these slag-mines and flay intruders on sight.

gather.cond: Tangling across the Abyss's endless layers; each cut forces a DC 13 Wis save or confused for 1 minute.
gather.riskWhy: The Abyss's layers crawl with demons; a confused cutter is easy prey.

gather.cond: Drawn from the River Styx itself; any flesh it touches loses its memories (DC 20 Int save).

guard.note: A nalfeshnee holds court on the riverbank and demands a soul-price from anyone who fills a flask.

gather.riskWhy: A nalfeshnee holds court on the Styx bank, and night hags haggle for souls nearby.

gather.cond: Crusted around the vents of the first Hell; the fumes force a DC 10 Con save.
gather.riskWhy: Mundane crust, but no vent in Hell goes unwatched for long.

gather.cond: Along the banks of the river of fire in the first Hell.
gather.riskWhy: The fire-river banks are hell hound runs and lemure wallows.

gather.cond: On the rotting shores of an Abyssal swamp layer; demons cultivate it for their mortal cults.

guard.note: A glabrezu tends the lotus beds for its mortal cults and bargains with or kills trespassers.

gather.riskWhy: A glabrezu tends these beds for its cults; it bargains first and kills second.

gather.cond: Carpets the battlefields of the fiends' endless war; it tries to drink from open cuts (1d4 necrotic).

guard.note: Barbed devil patrols still sweep the old battlefields of the fiends' war.

gather.riskWhy: Barbed devil patrols sweep the old battlefields, and the moss tattles with fresh blood.

gather.cond: Grows thick around the pits of the damned; their screams make gathering it a DC 12 Wis save vs fear.

guard.note: Bearded devils guard the pits of the damned and see nettle-pickers as escapees.

gather.riskWhy: The pits of the damned are guarded, and nettle-pickers look a lot like escapees.

gather.cond: Pried from the walls of an infernal treasure-vault — which will be missed.

guard.note: An erinyes guards the treasure-vault and hunts thieves through every layer they flee to.

gather.riskWhy: Robbing an infernal vault sets an erinyes on your trail across every plane.

gather.cond: Thick in the fungal layers of the Abyss; some are demons in disguise.
gather.riskWhy: Some of the toadstools are demons in disguise, and the rest grow on demon ground.

gather.cond: In the black crags of the grey wastes; staying too long drains the will to leave (DC 13 Wis save).
gather.riskWhy: The grey wastes' crags are night-hag country, with nightmares grazing the gloom.

gather.cond: From the grey wastes where souls fade to nothing; each handful whispers a forgotten name.
gather.riskWhy: Where souls fade, night hags and shadows come to pick over what is left.

environments.name: The Upper Planes
environments.desc: Sunlit mountains, endless golden fields and gardens of the gods where the virtuous dead find rest. The land is generous, but its guardians judge the heart of every visitor.
environments.forage: Foraging is easy for the good-hearted; those of evil intent must pass a DC 15 Wisdom save each day or be expelled from the plane. Taking more than you need is noticed.

gather.cond: Collected from golden meadows at dawn; only a pure vessel holds it.

guard.note: A deva walks the golden meadows at dawn and turns away those with impure intent.

gather.riskWhy: A deva walks these meadows at dawn and judges each gatherer; the impure are driven off.

gather.cond: Found in the resin of trees on the lower slopes of the celestial mountain; only while the sun stands at its peak.

guard.note: A young gold dragon suns itself on the slopes and asks a kindness in return for each piece.

gather.riskWhy: A young gold dragon suns on these slopes and expects a kindness per piece.

gather.cond: Drawn from sacred springs with a prayer of thanks.

guard.note: A couatl keeps the sacred spring and asks each visitor why they came.

gather.riskWhy: A couatl keeps the spring and questions everyone; a wrong answer ends peacefully or not.

gather.cond: In crystal outcrops on the celestial mountain.

guard.note: A pegasus herd nests among the crystal outcrops and drives off intruders.

gather.riskWhy: Pegasi nest among the outcrops and kick hard at anyone near their foals.

gather.cond: Settles on the ground each dawn, free to anyone in need.
gather.riskWhy: Freely given to anyone in need; no one here begrudges it.

gather.cond: Only from the golden trees of Elysium, shed as a gift to a worthy petitioner; cutting one earns a celestial's wrath.

guard.note: An adult gold dragon, a warden of Elysium, decides who is worthy of a bough.

gather.riskWhy: A gold dragon warden judges worth, and a cut bough brings celestial wrath.

gather.cond: From a tree of life, if its guardian deems you worthy; it must be asked for, never taken.

guard.note: A solar guards the tree of life and grants its sap only to those it judges worthy.

gather.riskWhy: A solar guards the tree of life; asking wrongly is the last mistake you make.

gather.cond: Floating on still, holy lakes; it closes if an evil-aligned creature approaches.

guard.note: A guardian naga dwells in the holy lake and tests the hearts of those who wade in.

gather.riskWhy: A guardian naga tests every heart that wades into its holy lake.

gather.cond: In the gardens of the celestial courts; the gardeners give it freely to those who ask for others' sake.

guard.note: A deva gardener gives the lily freely to the selfless and drives off the greedy.

gather.riskWhy: Deva gardeners give freely to the selfless and drive off the greedy.

gather.cond: In sunlit valleys; it opens only at noon, and must be picked in full sunlight.

guard.note: A gynosphinx in the service of a sun god keeps the noon valleys and questions every visitor.

gather.riskWhy: A gynosphinx keeps the noon valleys and quizzes every visitor.

gather.cond: In a hidden pool on the highest tier of the celestial mountain; a celestial guardian asks one question, and lies are fatal.

guard.note: An androsphinx asks the single question at the pool, and a lie is answered with its roar.

gather.riskWhy: One question from an androsphinx; a lie is answered by its roar.

gather.cond: Grows everywhere on the fields where heroes' spirits train; take only what they don't need.
gather.riskWhy: Heroic spirits train in these fields; greedy pickers may get a sparring partner.

gather.cond: Weeping from the resin-trees of the celestial groves; it flows when hymns are sung nearby.
gather.riskWhy: Celestial groves full of hymns; nothing here wishes a resin-gatherer harm.

gather.cond: From the silver birches of the wild forests of the upper realms; the trees must be asked first.
gather.riskWhy: Wild celestial forests: ask the trees first, or an awakened one or a treant answers.

gather.cond: Growing beside the observatories of the celestial mountain; the leaves only unfurl at dawn.
gather.riskWhy: Beside the celestial observatories; curious sphinxes and couatls come to see who's there.

environments.name: The Astral Sea
environments.desc: A silver void of drifting thought where time does not pass, dotted with colour pools, the petrified corpses of dead gods and the wreckage of lost ships. Astral raiders sail its currents on silver ships.
environments.forage: Movement is by thought (Intelligence-based speed); nothing ages, eats or grows here. Each day of foraging risks a psychic wind (DC 15 Wis save or stunned and lost).

gather.cond: From severed silver cords drifting where astral travellers died; it tries to reconnect to your own cord.

guard.note: A deva psychopomp gathers the cords of the astral dead and does not like them looted.

gather.riskWhy: Looting the cords of the astral dead offends a deva psychopomp and stirs their ghosts.

gather.cond: Condenses where thoughts gather; holding it floods your mind (DC 13 Wis save or stunned for 1 round).

guard.note: An aboleth adrift in the silver void feeds on the gathered thoughts and on the minds that come for them.

gather.riskWhy: An aboleth feeds on the thoughts that pool here, and on the minds that come for them.

gather.cond: Orbits the petrified dead gods; catching one takes a DC 17 Dex check.

guard.note: A reclusive archmage has built an observatory on the dead god and claims every shard in its orbit.

gather.riskWhy: A reclusive archmage claims every shard orbiting its dead-god observatory.

gather.cond: Collected in the wake of psychic winds; gathering it too soon exposes you to the wind's tail (DC 13 Wis save or 2d6 psychic).
gather.riskWhy: Dust drifting in open void after the wind; little shares the emptiness but phase spiders.

gather.cond: Scraped from the rim of a colour pool; touching the pool itself may drag you to another plane.

guard.note: Phase spiders web the rims of the colour pools, flickering between planes.

gather.riskWhy: Phase spiders web the pool rims, and the pools let other things slip through.

gather.cond: A flake chipped from the petrified corpse of a dead god; the god's last dream may flood your mind (DC 20 Wis save or madness).

guard.note: A lich has made the dead god its study and kills anyone who chips at its corpse.

gather.riskWhy: A lich has made the dead god its study, and celestials still mourn beside it.

gather.cond: Drifting chunks of shattered worlds; astral raiders watch the richest drift-fields.

guard.note: A young red dragon, escaped from an astral raider's stable, hunts the drift-fields.

gather.riskWhy: Raiders watch the richest drift-fields, and an escaped red dragon hunts them.

gather.cond: Grows on the hulls of wrecks that have drifted in the silver void for centuries.

guard.note: A shield guardian still stands watch over its long-dead master's wreck.

gather.riskWhy: A shield guardian still stands on its dead master's wreck, and the crew may linger too.

gather.cond: Only near the petrified corpses of dead gods; one find per month of searching at most.

guard.note: A planetar keeps vigil beside the dead god and guards what remains of it.

gather.riskWhy: A planetar keeps vigil by the dead god; a month of searching under its gaze.

gather.cond: Drifts freely through the void in clouds of crystal points.
gather.riskWhy: Crystal clouds drift free in the silver void; only a stray phase spider disturbs you.

gather.cond: Clustered on drifting rocks; it helps clear the mind against psychic winds.
gather.riskWhy: Drifting rocks are lonely places; the psychic wind is the bigger threat.

gather.cond: Forms on the rims of dried-up colour pools, still flickering with their last colours.
gather.riskWhy: Dry colour pools are dead doors; now and then something still flickers through.
